study: COLLECT015 residual-tiered memory gate falsification diagnostic
source: generated mathematical component episodes; not ordinary text, learned addressing or end-to-end architecture training
phase_keys: independent uniform phases; unit cos/sin keys; identical exact query addresses
compressed_read: equal mixture of two states; decayed before observed-value residual; plain unit-gain delta write to each state
distractors: three background records after each fact in the two distractor regimes; background keys not queried
cache: bounded FIFO unique-address store; invalidate matching old cache entry on every observed write, even if gate rejects; local last-eight-record buffer common to all policies
exact_lookup: nearest cos similarity accepted only within 1e-10 of identical unit address; otherwise compressed fallback
random_control: uniform event subset with exactly the residual policy's total admissions per episode; independent RNG and no query labels. This is retrospective count-matched evaluation control, not a deployable causal gate with future admission-count access.
queries: all active fact keys after the context stream; query labels never enter any read or admission decision
counterexample: repeated currently predictable fact omitted from exact cache, then a later correlated-address write destroys its compressed association
interpretation: Failure to beat matched random rejects the tested fixed-threshold policy under that regime/load; does not reject every hierarchical or query-aware memory design. No novelty claim, learned routing success, speed or global-attention replacement.
